div.div: مُصَعْلَكُ الرَّأْسِ A man round in the head: (O, K, TA:) or, as some say, small in the head. (TA.) And مَصَعْلَكٌ applied to a camel's hump, Such as is as though one rounded its upper part, and stretched up its lower part with the hand so as to make it assume that rounded form. (Sh, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
